title: mfe-composition-benchmark: three micro frontend composition strategies (Module Federation, Single-SPA, React Server Components) and their benchmark
description: Source code, automated benchmark pipeline (Lighthouse, interaction sessions, GitHub Actions) and raw results for the study 'Where should micro frontends be composed? An empirical comparison of Module Federation, Single-SPA and React Server Components'. The same four-page e-commerce application is implemented with Webpack Module Federation, Single-SPA and React Server Components in Next.js 15.
